scope: Speech-to-AU intensity prediction for lip-sync ONLY. Predicts AU25 (Lips Part) and AU26 (Jaw Drop) exclusively -- no other AU, no emotion/expression coverage (brow, eye, cheek AUs are entirely out of scope for this package).
why_only_au25_au26: Of 9 AUs available in GRID-SpeechAU-training-v1.1 (AU10/12/14/15/17/20/23/25/26) and 4 predictor architectures x 3 feature sets tried, AU25 and AU26 were the only two with consistently strong, model-agnostic test-set signal (ICC(3,1) in the 0.6-0.7 range across nearly every model/feature combination). Every other AU stayed near ICC(3,1)~0, i.e. statistically indistinguishable from not predicting anything -- shipping those would be actively misleading for a rendering pipeline.
dataset_source: GRID-SpeechAU-training-v1.1 (33 speakers, 32752 utterances, fixed speaker-disjoint split: train 26872 / validation 2993 / test 2887)
target: OpenFace raw_intensity (0-5 scale) for AU25 and AU26. NOTE: this is an OpenFace pseudo-label, not expert FACS ground truth -- performance reflects how well audio predicts OpenFace's output, not true muscular activation.

audio_feature_pipeline.combined: mfcc (13-d) concatenated with wavlm (768-d) -> 781-d, both resampled to 25fps then truncated to T = min(mfcc_len, wavlm_len)
audio_feature_pipeline.validated_against_shipped_features: MFCC: mean abs diff 3.2e-6 (float32 rounding only). WavLM: per-dimension correlation mean 0.955 (98.8% of dims > 0.9) against the dataset's own shipped float16 features -- residual difference attributable to float16 storage quantization, not an extraction bug.

AU25.picked_because: Best ICC(3,1) for AU25 among {TCN, TCN+GPT2, Mamba, Diffusion} x {mfcc, wavlm, combined} (12 combos)

AU26.picked_because: Best ICC(3,1) for AU26 among the same 12 combos

known_limitations: No coverage of AU10/12/14/15/17/20/23 -- all were tried and found unreliable (ICC(3,1) near 0); do not request them from this package.
No coverage of upper-face AUs (brow/eye/cheek) -- not present in the source dataset at all.

Trained and speaker-split-evaluated on GRID corpus audio only (short, clean, single-speaker read-speech clips, ~3s). Performance on noisy, multi-speaker, or emotionally expressive speech is unvalidated.
AU25/AU26 targets are OpenFace pseudo-labels, not expert-annotated ground truth.
Output is intensity only (0-5 continuous scale), not binary presence.

keys.timestamp_sec: float64[T], T = duration_sec * 25 (approx), one entry per output frame
